text:
Maya: Quick heads up — planning a 3-email re‑engagement mini-series for 'churned but opened' subscribers next week. Target: webinar signups + benchmark report downloads.
Jason: Nice. What's the segmentation logic? also subject line ideas?
Lina: Segment = users with opens in last 6 months but no clicks in 60 days. Exclude unsub/bounce/suppressed. SQL:
```sql
SELECT user_id, email
FROM analytics.users
WHERE last_open >= now() - interval '6 months'
AND last_click < now() - interval '60 days'
AND unsubscribed = false
AND bounced = false
```
Sam: Add filter: exclude users who attended webinar in last 12 months and those on dedicated enterprise lists. Also send throttling — ramp to 10k/hour then 50k/hr next day. Seed list + previews?
Jason: Subject A: "See what's new at Redwood — quick benchmark inside" Subject B: "Benchmarks + a short webinar — RSVP?" Preheader options ready.
Maya: Plan: Email A (Benchmark teaser) Tue 10am local, Email B (Deep dive + invite) Thu 10am local, Email C (Last chance + CTA) Mon 9am local. 3% holdout for control; 20% for subject-line A/B within segment.
Lina: For timezone sends use send_time = '10:00' + user.tz_offset, and window size = 2 hours. We should map timezone bins to cohorts to avoid overloading SMTP.
Sam: Deliverability checklist: seed list in Gmail/Outlook/Yahoo, spamtraps check, DKIM/SPF health, warmed IP pool. Also add 24h reengagement suppression for hard bounces that happen during the send.
Jason: CTA tracking: utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=reengage_q2&utm_content={variant}
Maya: Copy tasking — Jason to write variants, Lina to run segment query and export, Sam to run warmup. I'll own schedule in Braze and the campaign QA.
DeployBot: Campaign draft created: campaign/id=rdw-reengage-q2-171980 | status=draft
Lina: Reminder: include a plain-text fallback and an AMP-lite version? AMP might be overkill; at least ensure mobile render tests.
Maya: Agree on plain-text + responsive template. Quick checklist before send:
- seed previews ✅
- spam test ✅
- suppression lists applied ✅
- subject A/B config ✅
- holdout group setup ✅
- tracking UTM + webhook for conversions ✅
Jason: I'll drop copy drafts by EOD Friday. Can we do a full QA Tues AM before live?
Sam: Yup, deliverability smoke test Mon and full QA Tue.
Maya: Perfect. Tagging next steps: @Jason copy, @Lina export, @Sam warmup. Anything else?
Jason: GIF in Email B hero? keeps CTR up but increases size — I'll make a <300kb version.
Maya: Cool. Thanks everyone :rocket:
